summary: Engine actions are fully audited again, and PIM Manager runs without extra PowerShell modules.

fixes.title: Engine audit events are recorded again
fixes.text: Account creation, Temporary Access Pass, approval, licence and access request events from the engine were missing from the audit trail. They are recorded again.

fixes.title: No PowerShell modules, one way to sign in
fixes.text: PIM Manager no longer loads Microsoft PowerShell modules anywhere it runs for you, and every sign-in follows one path.

fixes.title: Setup signs you in through the browser
fixes.text: Setup scripts no longer borrow an existing Azure CLI sign-in. They use an open Invardia support session or sign you in in the browser.
fixes.action: Complete the browser sign-in when a setup script asks for it.

fixes.title: Hybrid worker needs fewer tools
fixes.text: Creating the hybrid worker's Active Directory groups and service account no longer needs the Active Directory PowerShell tools.
